doc: Comic panel SHAPES — the single source of truth for every render size in template-layout mode. Each shape fixes the pixel size of all four pipeline stages: `gen` (base image generation bucket, per model family), `wan` (Wan 2.2 i2v video render, both dims MUST be multiples of 16), `smooth` (upscale+RIFE target, node 5 of video_upscale_interp_api.json) and `still` (final still upscale target, upscale_to_fhd.py --target). The `landscape` row deliberately equals the legacy hardcodes (1344x768 / 1280x720 / 768x432 / 1920x1080) — a shot without a panel assignment resolves to `landscape`, which makes the legacy pipeline a special case of this table. Read by scripts/comic_page_registry.py (python) and src/comic/page-template-registry.service.ts (NestJS). Stage aspects may deviate from `aspect` by <2% (validated); the contain-fit placer in export_comic absorbs the sliver.
